# Tali Recorder Lessons

> Professional online recorder lessons taught by world-renowned musician Tali Rubinstein

Note: This describes Tali Rubinstein, the Israeli-American recorder player, composer, and educator (Berklee College of Music graduate), and her online lessons at talirecorderlessons.com. Her performing and press site is talirubinstein.com.

## About
Tali Rubinstein is a professional recorder player, composer, and music educator offering online recorder lessons to students of all ages and skill levels worldwide. She was the first recorder player to attend Berklee College of Music (full scholarship), and has established herself in jazz, pop, and R&B while teaching the next generation of recorder players. She has given workshops at Carnegie Hall, the Israel International Recorder Festival, Frankfurt University of Music and Performing Arts, and universities in Taiwan, the Philippines, Uruguay, and Spain. Her work was featured on a Latin Grammy-winning album and she was listed on Barack Obama’s favorite songs of 2018.

## Lesson specializations
- Beginner recorder lessons: for complete beginners and elementary players, no prior music reading required. https://www.talirecorderlessons.com/lessons/beginner-recorder-lessons
- Kids recorder lessons: age-appropriate instruction for young students, typically starting at age 8+. https://www.talirecorderlessons.com/lessons/kids-recorder-lessons
- Baroque recorder lessons: Handel, Bach, Vivaldi, Telemann, ornamentation, and historically informed technique. https://www.talirecorderlessons.com/lessons/baroque-recorder-lessons
- Advanced recorder lessons: virtuosic technique, jazz improvisation, and pre-professional/professional preparation. https://www.talirecorderlessons.com/lessons/advanced-recorder-lessons

## What lessons cover
- Technique development
- Tone production
- Breathing and articulation
- Baroque repertoire
- Contemporary music
- Performance preparation
- Music theory
- Sight reading

## What you need
- A recorder (soprano, alto, tenor, or bass)
- Computer, tablet, or smartphone with camera
- Stable internet connection
- Quiet practice space
- Music stand
